action.title: Create destination folder
action.description: Ensure a folder exists in your storage (created if missing).

params.name: folder
params.description: Folder path template; relative paths are inside the sync destination.

action.title: Rename destination file
action.description: Store the file under a different name. The local file is never renamed.

params.name: name
params.description: File name template.

action.title: Move to destination folder
action.description: Upload into this folder instead of mirroring the local folder. Relative paths are inside the sync configuration's destination; paths starting with / are from the root of your storage. Supports {{variables}}.

params.name: folder
params.description: Destination folder template.

action.title: Send notification
action.description: Show a notification in the web interface and/or the desktop app.

params.name: title
params.description: Notification title.

params.name: message
params.description: Body text.

params.name: level
params.description: Severity.

params.name: channel
params.description: Where to show it.

action.title: Synchronise file
action.description: Upload the file. Files that pass the sync configuration filters are uploaded by default; use this to make intent explicit.

action.title: Skip file
action.description: Do not upload the file. Skip always wins over Synchronise for the same automation.

params.name: reason
params.description: Shown in transfer history.

action.title: Start another sync task
action.description: Queue a scan of another sync configuration on the same device. Guarded against loops.

params.name: config
params.description: Name of the sync configuration to run.

action.title: Apply tag
action.description: Attach storage tags/categories to the uploaded file.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags (templates allowed).

condition.title: Date created or modified
condition.description: Compares the file's created or modified time with a fixed date.

params.name: field
params.description: Which timestamp to compare.

params.name: operator
params.description: before or after.

params.name: date
params.description: YYYY-MM-DD (local midnight) or an RFC 3339 timestamp.

params.name: negate
params.description: Invert the result of the condition.

condition.title: File extension matches
condition.description: The file extension is one of the listed values.

params.name: extensions
params.description: Extensions without the dot, case-insensitive.

params.name: negate
params.description: Invert the result of the condition.

condition.title: File age
condition.description: Compares the number of days since the file was last modified.

params.name: operator
params.description: gt, gte, lt, lte or eq.

params.name: days
params.description: Age in whole days.

params.name: negate
params.description: Invert the result of the condition.

condition.title: AND / OR group
condition.description: Combines several rules. mode "all" is AND, "any" is OR. Rules can nest groups.

params.name: mode
params.description: all = every rule must pass (AND); any = at least one (OR).

params.name: rules
params.description: List of {"kind": <condition kind>, "params": {...}} objects.

params.name: negate
params.description: Invert the result of the condition.

condition.title: Filename contains
condition.description: The file name contains the given text.

params.name: text
params.description: Text to look for.

params.name: case_sensitive
params.description: Match case exactly.

params.name: negate
params.description: Invert the result of the condition.

condition.title: Filename matches pattern
condition.description: The file name matches a glob pattern such as "*.tmp" or "Replay_*".

params.name: pattern
params.description: Glob pattern.

params.name: case_sensitive
params.description: Match case exactly.

params.name: negate
params.description: Invert the result of the condition.

condition.title: Folder path matches
condition.description: The file's path relative to the sync root matches a glob. Use ** to match any number of folders.

params.name: pattern
params.description: Glob pattern over the relative path.

params.name: case_sensitive
params.description: Match case exactly.

params.name: negate
params.description: Invert the result of the condition.

condition.title: File size
condition.description: Compares the file size with a value.

params.name: operator
params.description: gt, gte, lt, lte or eq.

params.name: bytes
params.description: Size in bytes.

params.name: negate
params.description: Invert the result of the condition.

condition.title: Metadata matches
condition.description: Compares any automation variable (see the variable reference) with a value.

params.name: variable
params.description: Variable name, e.g. file.parent_name or sync.files_failed.

params.name: operator
params.description: Comparison. matches uses a glob; gt/lt compare numbers or dates.

params.name: value
params.description: Value to compare with (ignored for exists/empty).

params.name: case_sensitive
params.description: Match case exactly for text comparisons.

params.name: negate
params.description: Invert the result of the condition.

trigger.title: File created
trigger.description: A new file appeared in a synchronised folder (fires once the file has stopped changing).

params.name: configs
params.description: Only fire for these sync configuration names. Empty means every sync configuration the automation is attached to.

trigger.title: File deleted
trigger.description: A file was removed locally. Server copies are never deleted by this trigger; use it for notifications or tagging.

params.name: configs
params.description: Only fire for these sync configuration names. Empty means every sync configuration the automation is attached to.

trigger.title: File extension matched
trigger.description: A file with one of the listed extensions was created or modified.

params.name: extensions
params.description: Extensions without the dot, case-insensitive.

params.name: configs
params.description: Only fire for these sync configuration names. Empty means every sync configuration the automation is attached to.

trigger.title: File modified
trigger.description: An existing synchronised file changed size or modification time.

params.name: configs
params.description: Only fire for these sync configuration names. Empty means every sync configuration the automation is attached to.

trigger.title: File renamed
trigger.description: A file was renamed or moved inside a synchronised folder. file.old_path holds the previous relative path.

params.name: configs
params.description: Only fire for these sync configuration names. Empty means every sync configuration the automation is attached to.

trigger.title: File size threshold reached
trigger.description: A file was created or modified and is at least the given size.

params.name: bytes
params.description: Minimum size in bytes.

params.name: configs
params.description: Only fire for these sync configuration names. Empty means every sync configuration the automation is attached to.

trigger.title: Folder changed
trigger.description: Any file event inside a folder whose relative path matches the pattern.

params.name: folder
params.description: Glob matched against the folder's path relative to the sync root ("" is the root).

params.name: configs
params.description: Only fire for these sync configuration names. Empty means every sync configuration the automation is attached to.

trigger.title: Scheduled interval
trigger.description: Fires repeatedly on the desktop client at a fixed interval.

params.name: every_minutes
params.description: Interval in minutes (5 minutes to 7 days).

trigger.title: Synchronisation completed
trigger.description: A sync run finished with no failed transfers.

params.name: configs
params.description: Only fire for these sync configuration names. Empty means every sync configuration the automation is attached to.

trigger.title: Synchronisation failed
trigger.description: A sync run finished with one or more failed transfers, or could not run.

params.name: configs
params.description: Only fire for these sync configuration names. Empty means every sync configuration the automation is attached to.
